action: cross-model takeaway #1
lesson: torch.compile is a prerequisite for large GEAK wins — with torch.compile, GEAK reached up to +14.72%; without it, gains were <=1.76%

action: cross-model takeaway #2
lesson: GEAK E2E gain depends on concurrency (CONC) — sweet spot around CONC=4; at high concurrency, gains are diluted by the pipeline

action: cross-model takeaway #3
lesson: Server parameter tuning is often more effective than GEAK — e.g. Kimi vLLM +84%, DSR1 +13.9%

action: cross-model takeaway #4
lesson: Already highly tuned models (gpt-oss) had little headroom — GPU utilization ~94.7%, 95%+ vendor kernels

action: cross-model takeaway #5
lesson: Backend switches + scheduling modes outperform parameter sweeps — GLM-5-FP8: backend switches gave +16.2% combined vs <1% from any single parameter

action: torch.compile on MoE+MLA+FP8
lesson: torch.compile INCOMPATIBLE: MLA + FP8 causes CUDA graph capture failure. Must run without torch.compile.

action: GEAK on aiter vendor kernels (gemm_a8w8_blockscale, fused_rms_fp8)
lesson: GEAK 0% E2E on vendor aiter kernels. Micro +44-127% but E2E -19.9% due to register pressure. Vendor kernels already AMD-engineer-optimized.
context: Validated 2026-03-21. Controlled test. AST patching required.

action: num-continuous-decode-steps 4→8
lesson: decode-steps 8 gives +13.9% on DSR1 (controlled pair: 2229→2539 tok/s). Highly model-dependent — gpt-oss TP=8 showed 0%.
context: Validated 2026-03-22. Controlled pair test, same session, cuda-graph-max-bs=64

action: GEAK RMSNorm single-pass via torch.compile + Inductor cache patching
lesson: Single-pass RMSNorm eliminates 50% memory reads. +14.72% at CONC=4. CONC-dependent: -5.9% at CONC=1 (L2 cache), ~0% at CONC=16 (GPU saturated). Average +2.20% across 9 configs.
context: Validated 2026-03-23. CONC=4, ISL=1024, OSL=256, TP=1. Must patch STANDALONE files not graph modules.

action: SGLang vs vLLM GEAK RMSNorm comparison
lesson: SGLang +14.7% from GEAK RMSNorm but vLLM ~0%. vLLM uses more C++ kernels so RMSNorm is smaller share. vLLM Inductor level=3 already compresses headroom.

action: Attention backend configuration for MoE+MLA TP=8
lesson: MUST use split backends: --decode-attention-backend triton --prefill-attention-backend aiter. Unified aiter fails (8 heads/partition < 16 min). MUST set SGLANG_ROCM_FUSED_DECODE_MLA=0. FP8 KV cache crashes.
context: Validated 2026-03-23. Config discovery from SGLang test suite saved 30+ min.

action: Invalid +40.4% GEAK claim due to benchmark parameter drift
lesson: Baseline CONC=64, GEAK test CONC=128 (omitted --max-concurrency). Also decode-steps 4→8, mem-fraction 0.8→0.85. Fair A/B: only +0.81%. TPOT increased 172→234ms (smoking gun: batching not kernel speed).
context: Controlled A/B with matched params. Previous +40.4% was INVALID.

action: gpu-memory-utilization 0.85→0.90 + max-num-seqs 256
lesson: vLLM server param tuning gave +84% (141→259 tok/s). Much more impactful than GEAK (+1.76%). P0 recommendation: switch to SGLang (324 > 264 tok/s).

action: torch.compile + SWA incompatibility
lesson: SWA memory pool doesn't support CUDA graph capture with torch.compile. aiter attention backend also NOT SUPPORTED (requires triton/trtllm_mha). FP8 KV cache incompatible with SWA.

action: cuda-graph-max-bs 4→16
lesson: CUDA graph coverage expansion: +35% at CONC=4 (793→1073 tok/s). Most impactful single parameter when misconfigured. Rule: always set cuda-graph-max-bs >= max CONC.
context: Validated 2026-03-22. TP=1, ISL=1024, OSL=256, decode-steps=8 baseline

action: --nsa-decode-backend aiter (tilelang→aiter CK)
lesson: Switches NSA decode kernel from tilelang to aiter CK. +3.1% individually. Combined with mixed-chunk: +16.2% (super-linear synergy).

action: --enable-mixed-chunk scheduling
lesson: Overlaps prefill/decode in same forward batch. +2.9% individually. Combined with aiter NSA decode: +16.2%. More tokens per forward × faster per-token = compounding.

action: Combined: aiter NSA decode + mixed-chunk scheduling
lesson: Super-linear synergy: 3.1% + 2.9% individually → +16.2% combined. Mixed-chunk feeds more tokens; aiter processes each faster. Always test winners together — gains are NOT additive.

action: MI355X vs NVIDIA B200 throughput comparison
lesson: B200: ~660 tok/s/GPU. MI355X optimized: ~408 tok/s/GPU (TP=4). Gap: ~38%. B200 uses TRT-LLM NSA, FlashInfer MoE, FP8 KV, DeepGEMM. FP8 KV cache fails on MI355X NSA path — blocks a key NVIDIA technique.

action: operational pitfall
lesson: Always include --max-concurrency $CONC in benchmark commands. Omitting it sends ALL prompts at once, inflating throughput.

action: operational pitfall
lesson: Save baseline server config to file and source it for all re-tests. Server param drift (decode-steps, mem-fraction) invalidates comparisons.

action: operational pitfall
lesson: GEAK agent may write output to input file path instead of output dir. Always inspect the GEAK CLI output directory / Ray task workspace and copy the correct file from shared storage.

action: operational pitfall
lesson: Always filter traces before TraceLens. Raw traces are 349MB (97% python_function). Filtered traces are ~5MB.

action: operational pitfall
lesson: MUST use Python AST for aiter source patching. Naive function-end detection deletes module-level variables (make_kernel_repr), causing NameError.

action: InferenceX baseline already optimal — decode-steps, mem-fraction, chunk-prefill, schedule-policy all tested
lesson: InferenceX fp8_mi355x config (aiter, chunk-196k, decode-steps-4, mem-0.8, fp8-kv) is already near-optimal. decode-steps 8 gave +0.4% (vs KB +13.9% from weaker baseline 278.6→317.4). chunk-32k/lpm/decode-16 all OOM. No backend switch >1%.

action: MI355X vs B200 comparison: MI355X 43-50% lower tok/s/GPU but 14% better TPOT at CONC=64
lesson: MI355X throughput gap vs B200 is 43-50% across CONC=4-64. Root cause: TTFT 2.3x worse (prefill bottleneck), not decode. TPOT actually 14% faster on MI355X. E2EL comparable at high CONC. Prefill optimization (chunked-prefill tuning, dp-attention, ep) is the priority path.
context: Sweep 2026-04-01, InferenceX baseline config, ISL/OSL=1024/1024, CONC=4,8,16,32,64

action: claw-local combined param tuning
lesson: Claw branch local mode: identical results to main branch. Combined params +1.6%. Confirms refactoring preserved functional equivalence.

action: DP attention at CONC<=64
lesson: DP attention (dp=8) HURTS at CONC<=64: -34% at CONC=64, -57% at CONC=4. Splits batch across data-parallel groups causing overhead at moderate concurrency. Only consider for CONC>256.

action: Full DFS optimization: baseline 1.13x -> MTP 1.47x B200
lesson: DSR1 FP8 on MI355X with SGLang: baseline already 1.13x B200 at CONC=64. MTP EAGLE pushes to 1.47x. At CONC=128: 738.11 tok/s/GPU. Server param tuning and mixed-chunk gave <1% on top of InferenceX config. Key B200 scheduling params (recv-interval, stream-interval) transfer well to MI355X.

action: MTP EAGLE (3 steps, topk=1, draft=4) + scheduler tuning
lesson: MTP EAGLE speculative decoding is the single biggest optimization lever for DSR1. At CONC=64: 488.45 tok/s/GPU (1.47x B200, 1.30x baseline). Scheduling params critical: scheduler-recv-interval=10 + stream-interval=30 fix TTFT from 5010ms to 425ms and boost throughput 22%. At CONC=4: 2x baseline. Requires SGLANG_USE_ROCM700A=1.

action: Target: NVIDIA B200 8659.95 tok/s/GPU vs MI355X (pending baseline)
lesson: Gap: TBD. B200 uses TRT-LLM with FP8 KV cache, FlashInfer MoE, PIECEWISE CUDA graphs. MI355X has AITER attention, triton RoPE, fuse_rope_kvcache. FlashInfer MoE CUDA-only, piecewise CUDA graphs disabled on ROCm.

action: CK MXFP4 MoE GEMM alignment failure: intermediate_size=2880 not multiple of 256 at any TP
lesson: gpt-oss-120b CK MXFP4 MoE GEMM requires intermediate_size_per_partition%256==0, but 2880 is NOT divisible by 256 at any TP (1/2/4/8). Triton fallback is inherent to model architecture. Fix requires CK library change or padding.

action: MI355X vs B200: 3464 vs 8660 tok/s/GPU at TP=2 CONC=64 (60% gap)
lesson: 60% gap to B200. Root causes: CK MXFP4 MoE Triton fallback (-20-40%), FlashInfer MoE CUDA-only (-15-30%), TRT-LLM framework advantage (-10-20%). Best MI355X: 6929 tok/s at CONC=64 TP=2.

action: torch.compile L3 + CUDA graphs: ESSENTIAL. enforce-eager = -85.8%
lesson: vLLM torch.compile level=3 with FULL_AND_PIECEWISE CUDA graphs is ESSENTIAL for gpt-oss-120b. Without it (--enforce-eager): TPOT 4.13ms->29.26ms (-85.8%). InferenceX MI355X config is already optimal baseline.

action: TP=1 vs TP=2: +41-52% tok/s/GPU by eliminating AllReduce
lesson: gpt-oss-120b at mxfp4 is only ~60GB weights, fits easily on single MI355X (256GB). TP=1 eliminates AllReduce, giving 5230 vs 3707 tok/s/GPU at CONC=64 (+41%), and 11643 vs 8220 tok/s/GPU at CONC=256 (+42%). Deploy as 2x TP=1 instances for max throughput.

action: kv-cache-dtype fp8: enables higher concurrency scaling, no accuracy loss
lesson: FP8 KV cache halves KV memory with zero accuracy impact (GSM8K 96.4% vs 95.1% baseline). Critical enabler for CONC=256+ on MI355X. At CONC=64 only +0.9%, but at CONC=512 reaches 9919 tok/s/GPU.

action: NCCL_ALGO=Ring + NCCL_MIN_NCHANNELS=16 + NCCL_MAX_NCHANNELS=32: +3.9-4.7% at high CONC
lesson: RCCL Ring algorithm with 16-32 channels improves TP=2 AllReduce by 3.9% at CONC=256 and 4.7% at CONC=512. Effect is minimal at low concurrency (<1%).

action: MI355X BEATS B200: TP=1x2 at CONC=256 = 11643 tok/s/GPU (134% of B200)
lesson: After optimization, MI355X TP=1x2 at CONC=256 gives 23286 tok/s total vs B200 17320 tok/s (+34.4%). Even TP=2 at CONC=256 reaches 94.9% of B200. Key: fp8 KV + fuse_act_padding + RCCL Ring + TP=1.

action: fuse_act_padding ROCm compilation pass: +2.3-3.4%
lesson: ROCm-specific fuse_act_padding pass fuses RMSNorm+padding ops, providing 2.3% at CONC=4 and 3.4% at CONC=64. Enable via -cc.pass_config.fuse_act_padding=True. Auto-enabled fuse_norm_quant and fuse_act_quant also contribute.

action: MoRI step-window profile num_steps=50 with TraceLens
lesson: Bounded MoRI profile trace can preserve GPU events and TraceLens identifies aiter fused MoE (~35%), quickreduce/allreduce (~19%), and FP8 GEMM dispatch hotspots; these are dispatch/communication/vendor paths, not simple direct Triton patch targets.

action: MoRI 1P1D chunked-prefill-size 131072 plus NCCL Ring channels32
lesson: For DeepSeek-R1-0528 SGLang MoRI 1P1D on MI300X, prefill chunked-prefill-size=131072 plus NCCL_ALGO=Ring/MIN=MAX_NCHANNELS=32 improved controlled CONC=64 ISL/OSL=1024/1024 throughput from 1458.46 to 1486.31 tok/s (+1.91%); final sweep best was 1495.72 tok/s.
